synonyms: Croton capitatus var. lindheimeri (Engelm. & A.Gray) Müll.Arg.
taxonomic_note: Accepted as a distinct species by current POWO and Flora of North America. Older Central Texas material commonly appears under Croton capitatus var. lindheimeri.
look_here_first: Look for ochraceous yellow-brown pubescence on young growth, consistently acute leaf tips, and pistillate sepal tips that remain straight to slightly incurved rather than flaring outward.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is locked under the modern species concept through synonym-reconciled herbarium evidence. Williamson evidence is outside the project target zone and is not counted.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification. Preserve the one-county HOLD.

best_field_traits: ochraceous yellow-brown pubescence on young growth
ovate-lanceolate leaves with consistently acute tips
sepal tips straight to slightly incurved rather than recurved outward
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Separate from true C. capitatus with young pubescence color, consistently acute leaves, and non-recurving pistillate sepals.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Ochraceous young growth + acute leaf tips + straight/slightly incurved pistillate sepals.

photo_note: Current user-approved habit/fruit candidates are useful; a sepal-posture comparison remains the highest-value visual addition.

images.role: Habit, narrow acute-tipped leaves and hairy shoots
